report.answer_summary: [supported:finding-f73c8d6c97302e9212b7d1c4] The python.org downloads landing page identifies the latest stable CPython release as 3.15.1, with release date Oct. 21, 2026, shown in the page heading and in the release-version table. (passages: cli-run-fetch-wg2-73d891bf--web-ref-0:html:0,cli-run-fetch-wg2-73d891bf--web-ref-0:html:3,cli-run-fetch-wg2-73d891bf--web-ref-0:html:5) [supported:finding-437791986c074f8f93207ad9] The downloads landing page also lists Python 3.15.0 as released Oct. 9, 2026 and shows the 3.15 branch in bugfix maintenance, while 3.16 is listed as a pre-release. (passages: cli-run-fetch-wg2-73d891bf--web-ref-0:html:4,cli-run-fetch-wg2-73d891bf--web-ref-0:html:5) [supported:finding-f22b3fc1f40c310a7a0fb189] The developer guide status table lists the 3.15 branch as bugfix with first release 2026-10-09 and end of life 2031-10, but it does not state a latest stable patch version (3.15.1) or an Oct. 21, 2026 patch release date. (passages: cli-run-fetch-wg2-73d891bf--web-ref-1:html:1) [supported:finding-c725a330d9efa96b6d863b0d] Because the developer guide status table provides only branch-level status and first-release dates, it is insufficient as a source for the latest stable CPython patch release version and its release date. (passages: cli-run-fetch-wg2-73d891bf--web-ref-1:html:1) [supported:finding-eb3e51cc5ee92f13e32ea162] The two official python.org pages agree at the branch level that 3.15 is the latest stable branch in bugfix maintenance with 2026-10-09 as its first release, but the developer guide status table lacks the patch-level version and release date needed to confirm agreement with the downloads page's 3.15.1 / Oct. 21, 2026 statement. (passages: cli-run-fetch-wg2-73d891bf--web-ref-0:html:4,cli-run-fetch-wg2-73d891bf--web-ref-0:html:5,cli-run-fetch-wg2-73d891bf--web-ref-1:html:1)
